subject: Observability integrations cohort — governance playbook & PSA
messages:
From: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@datadog.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Observability partner cohort: pilot & governance proposal

Tessa —

Thanks for taking this early look. Datadog is interested in running a small integrations cohort with Redwood + Grafana + a systems integrator (OpsRise) to accelerate joint reference deployments and a shared go-to-market track. High-level proposal: 

- 6-week cohort (3 pilots) focused on: automated OTLP routing, unified tracing surface, and retention-cost tradeoffs.
- Governance: weekly syncs, a one-pager playbook for engineers, and a shared runbook for SLA/backout.
- Commercial: cost-share for lab hours + a simple PSA for professional services.

Are you open to a pilot cohort like this? If so, we can share a roster and draft PSA to speed contracting. Would love a 30-min sync this week to align scope and owners.

Cheers,
Sarah
--
Sarah Kim
Strategic Partnerships, Datadog

Attachment stubs: none in this message.

Subject: Re: Observability partner cohort: pilot & governance proposal

Sarah — thanks, this sounds useful and very aligned with what our field team has been asking for. Short responses / next steps: 

- Cohort scope: we support the three focus areas, suggest adding a short eval to measure end-to-end token/cost delta for prefix caching.
- Owners: Marissa will be PM for engineer enablement; Ben will handle partner commercial. Laura will provide GTM collateral.
- Contracting: attaching a PSA draft and a starter onboarding schedule (XLSX) — these are intentionally minimal.

Action items:
1) We will share the cohort roster (attached CSV).
2) Can Datadog confirm a list of sandbox clusters and whether Grafana needs a separate lab account?
3) Please confirm a kickoff week — we prefer Nov 8 week.

Attaching: cohort-roster.csv, psa-draft.pdf, onboarding-schedule.xlsx

Thanks — I can host the 30-min sync Thur 10/28 at 3pm PT or Fri 10/29 at 10am PT; pick whichever works.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Alliances (Interim) | Redwood Inference

Looping in a couple of quick commercial notes so contracting doesn't block the runway: 

- PSA: good to keep it time-and-materials with a capped not-to-exceed for the pilot. I flagged the hourly rates in the draft, please confirm Datadog / OpsRise rates.
- Mutual action plan: recommend a 4-column MAP (owner, deliverable, timing, sign-off). Can someone on the Datadog side commit to the MAP by next Wednesday?
- Billing: Redwood typically invoices 50% on SOW signature, 50% on pilot close — happy to align if partners prefer a different split.

If we lock these items this week we can start procurement for lab instances next Monday.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference

On Fri, Oct 29, 2027 at 10:03 AM Devon Patel <devon@grafana.com> wrote:

Thanks all — Grafana is in. A few clarifications from our side: 
- Resource commit: we'll provide one solutions engineer (0.5 FTE) for the cohort and a test Grafana Cloud org.
- Labs: Grafana can host dashboards/datasources; Datadog will need to expose any OTLP endpoints to the test environment.
- Timeline: Nov 8 kickoff works. Suggest a pre-kickoff readiness check on Nov 3 (30 minutes) to validate keys, RBAC, and sample traces.

I'll have our legal rep review the PSA but the commercial model (T&M with NTE cap) is fine.

—Devon
